title: Contrast is fixed with a darker destructive fill and role tokens for text and icons
context: Teal primary icons and coral destructive text fell below AA on dark cards, and selected GamePanel buttons put near-white text on coral.
decision: The destructive fill is darkened and keeps a white foreground. A new `--destructive-text` colours text and icons on card and accent surfaces: in light mode it is the darkened destructive, in dark mode brand coral (5.88:1 on the dark card). Dark mode gets a lighter primary variant, `--primary-text`, for icons and text on dark surfaces; in light mode it equals primary. The app court in-zone uses `bg-court`, and the back zone is extracted to `--court-back-zone`. A token contrast check pins every pair at 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for icons.

alternatives.option: Lighten or darken the single tokens in place
alternatives.reason: One value cannot pass on both the light card and the dark card; the fill and the text need separate roles.

alternatives.option: Check contrast by hand in review
alternatives.reason: Regressions return silently the next time a token is edited.

consequences: Components choose between the destructive fill and destructive-text by role.
The contrast check fails when a token edit breaks a listed pair.
